title: AI Gateway Vertex AI passthrough routes: Claude and MaaS models must forward passthrough and proxy calls to their delegate, not to Gemini
answers: Why does POST /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages return 400 for a Claude model hosted on Vertex AI?
Where is the raw proxy route for a Claude endpoint on Vertex AI handled?
Does a Vertex AI MaaS endpoint accept the OpenAI chat completions passthrough at /gateway/openai/v1/chat/completions?
Why does a raw proxy request to a Vertex AI endpoint reach the Gemini host with a Vertex token?
body:
Path: Passthrough and raw proxy requests (`/gateway/anthropic/v1/messages`, `/gateway/openai/v1/chat/completions`, `/gateway/proxy/{endpoint}/...`) on a Vertex AI endpoint enter `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:VertexAIProvider._passthrough`, `_proxy` and `_extract_passthrough_token_usage`, which dispatch to the Claude or MaaS delegate by model type and to the Gemini implementation for Gemini models.
Rule: `VertexAIProvider` forwards these three methods to the delegate when one exists. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._passthrough` must not inherit `AnthropicProvider._passthrough` (it posts to base_url + "messages" with the model in the body); it builds `{model}:rawPredict` or `:streamRawPredict` via `_get_passthrough_path` with `anthropic_version` in the body and no `model` field. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._proxy` maps only `v1/messages` onto those paths and raises 501 for any other path, because Vertex exposes only the Messages API for Claude and `AnthropicProvider._proxy` would strip `/models` from the base URL.
Symptom: The Anthropic passthrough on a Claude Vertex endpoint was rejected with 400, and the raw proxy route was sent to generativelanguage.googleapis.com with a Vertex OAuth token.
Constraints: Gemini models keep the unchanged Gemini path. The MaaS raw proxy still runs through `proxy_root_url()`, which strips the `/openapi` segment; that is a separate fix. Changes to Vertex Claude request shape must keep the model out of the body.
applies: Applies to AI Gateway passthrough and raw proxy routes for endpoints whose model is a Vertex AI Claude or MaaS model.
says: Anthropic messages passthrough returns bad request errors for Claude models on Vertex AI.
Raw proxy requests to Vertex Claude endpoints are incorrectly forwarded to Gemini servers.
Support standard Anthropic messages API calls for Vertex AI hosted Claude endpoints.
Proxy calls to unsupported Vertex Claude routes should return a not implemented error.
Allow OpenAI chat completion passthrough calls to Vertex Model as a Service endpoints.
search: For Vertex AI Claude and MaaS endpoints in AI Gateway, `mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:VertexAIProvider` must dispatch `_passthrough`, `_proxy`, and `_extract_passthrough_token_usage` to delegate providers rather than the Gemini implementation. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._passthrough` targets `{model}:rawPredict` or `:streamRawPredict` via `_get_passthrough_path` with `anthropic_version` in the payload and excludes the model field, avoiding `AnthropicProvider._passthrough`. `_VertexAIClaudeProvider._proxy` exclusively handles `v1/messages` and raises 501 for other paths, while Gemini models retain their default path and MaaS raw proxy uses `proxy_root_url()`.
